title: helianthemum polyanthum var. hirsutum
intro: Helianthemum polyanthum var. hirsutum, commonly known as hairy rockrose, is a plant species within the Cistaceae family. It is a flowering perennial that is native to the Mediterranean region, and its flowers are known to produce a fragrant, rose-like scent. The hairy rockrose has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relieving anxiety and stress, and promoting a good night's sleep due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
